segments.name: Exploration & Production
segments.evidence: An Exploration & Production segment that encompasses the activities of exploration and production of oil and natural gas, as well as carbon storage activities, conducted in about 50 countries;

segments.name: Integrated LNG
segments.description: Covers the integrated gas chain including upstream and midstream LNG, biogas and gas trading activities.
segments.evidence: An Integrated LNG segment covering the integrated gas chain (including upstream and midstream LNG activities) as well as biogas and gas trading activities;

segments.name: Integrated Power
segments.evidence: An Integrated Power segment covering generation, storage, electricity trading and B2B-B2C distribution of gas and electricity;

segments.name: Refining & Chemicals
segments.description: Industrial hub comprising refining, petrochemicals and specialty chemicals, plus oil trading, maritime transport and hydrogen.
segments.evidence: A Refining & Chemicals segment constituting a major industrial hub comprising the activities of refining, petrochemicals and specialty chemicals.

segments.name: Marketing & Services
segments.description: Global supply and marketing of petroleum products.
segments.evidence: A Marketing & Services segment including the global activities of supply and marketing in the field of petroleum products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay TotalEnergies for sales of crude oil, natural gas, LNG, electricity, refined petroleum products and chemicals.

changes.text: In 2025 hydrogen activities previously reported within the Integrated LNG segment were moved into the Refining & Chemicals segment.
changes.evidence: This segment also includes oil supply and trading activities, maritime transport, and hydrogen activities previously reported within the Integrated LNG segment;
